page.overview:
What is Yukari?

Yukari was an ancient civilization that existed some time in the past few centuries. It was a small, independent city-state, surrounded by larger nations that it was constantly fighting off. It was eventually absorbed by one of its neighbors, and due to the active warzone surrounding its former location, much of the information about it has been lost.

Not much is known about Yukari's geography, but it was surrounded by enemy nations. The country contained a palace built out of stone, though it was destroyed; the kitchen, specifically, was destroyed in a fire. The ground was made of limestone, and as such trees did not naturally grow.

While Yukari functioned largely independently, it did trade with World Government-affiliated countries.

Yukari had its own language and writing system, which was written using a alphabet. The language was discovered to be similar to another language from the same time period called , allowing it to be translated by Nico Robin and Koala. The oral language, meanwhile, is very similar to the language used by the World Government, allowing it to be translated by ear.
